extracted.name: Texas Deer Chili
extracted.description: Cubed venison is combined with kidney beans, green chiles and broth seasoned with oregano, cumin, garlic and paprika in this slow cooker chili.
ingredient_lines: 1 (4 ounce) can diced green chile peppers
2 (15 ounce) cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instruction_lines: In a large skillet over medium heat, cook venison, onion and garlic in oil until meat is browned. Transfer to a slow cooker and stir together with chiles, beans, broth oregano, cumin, salt and paprika. Cook on medium 4 to 5 hours.
